approvalScope: Grammar-only forward revision of explicitly bound version1 units. Existing source/review bytes, IDs, all question arrays and answer keys remain preserved; no additional practice supply is claimed.

findings: Crossover and period describe repeated-condition structure; sequence and randomisation concern order and assignment.
Carryover is persistence, washout the intended diminishing interval; washout is not guaranteed to remove every influence.
Within-person comparison does not remove time variation. Assessor masking is distinguished from participant knowledge.
Unused allocation, baseline, endpoint, volunteer and withdrawn were checked across all slots. The text gives no actual intervention protocol.
Grammar-only correction in whole: instead of treat → instead of treating; the gerund follows the preposition without changing the sentence's subject, object, condition or assertion.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: same participant both conditions different times定义crossover交叉设计。allocation分配总过程、baseline起点、endpoint结果不指同人轮换结构。
defined time span each condition定义period阶段。sequence为阶段次序、baseline开始值、endpoint终点不是持续时间段本身。
intervention label defined treatment处理。volunteer为参与者、endpoint测量结果、allocation分配不命名被比较条件处理。
order conditions定义sequence顺序。comparison为比较过程、period单阶段、baseline起始状态都不是先后组合。
chance rather chosen order定义randomised随机化。masked为不知标签而非随机选序，withdrawn为退出，其他候选不作该分配性质分词。
effect persists first into next定义carryover残留效应。washout间隔旨在减残留而非残留本身，variability泛变化、baseline基线不直接指前期延续影响。
interval allowing effects diminish定义washout洗脱间隔。baseline起始时点不保证留间隔，endpoint结果、allocation分配不是这里的阶段之间等待。
within participant comparing two conditions定义comparison比较。allocation把人或序分派不同于条件结果对比，variability是差异现象不是比较动作。
differences changes across periods为variability变异。carryover仅一种延续效应不能概括所有差异，baseline起点、endpoint单结果非总变化。
assessor unaware condition defines masked遮盲。randomised指抽分不保证不知道，withdrawn退出不是保评者不知，其他候选不合。

findings: Unit, assignment, randomisation and baseline are different design elements. Control is a defined comparison, not a promise of zero experiences.
Exposure and compliance are separate from receiving an invitation. Spillover concerns indirect effects on connected nonrecipients.
Cluster allocation needs matching design; stable conditions cannot be inferred from a shared programme name.
Unused attrition, untreated, variance, version and weighted were checked across all gaps. No real social experiment or personal data is used.
Grammar-only correction in whole: instead of use → instead of using; the gerund follows the preposition without changing the sentence's subject, object, condition or assertion.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: entity counted analysis定义unit分析单位。cluster是一种分组单位但此处概念可账户人家庭，assignment为分配、version为版本均非通用分析实体概念。
allocated group记录定义assignment分配。exposure实际遇到、compliance遵从均后续事件，variance变异不指被划到哪条件。
used chance allocation定义randomisation随机化。attrition退出、spillover间接效应、baseline起点、control比较组不指抽签分配。
stated comparison arrangement定义control对照条件。untreated未接受可处理性质但不保证无事，本文强调对照非绝对空白，weighted加权非条件名。
before intervention starting state定义baseline基线。version版本、assignment分配、exposure接触不等前测起点；其他词不合。
what actually encountered定义exposure实际接触。assignment仅机会分配、compliance遵从是接触与分配关系不等本身，其他名词不合。
following allocated arrangement定义compliance遵从。exposure只是遇到可能非分配安排，attrition退出相反事件，variance变异不表遵从。
effect reaches nonrecipients neighbours定义spillover溢出效应。attrition是流失、variance总变异、version版本不是间接受益，其他候选不合。
group connected purpose定义cluster群组。unit泛单位但第1空已锁总定义，这里特指一起分配的组；version版本、control条件不等连接群体。
unchanged relevant respects定义stable稳定。weighted为加权而非条件不变，untreated未处理、randomisation名词均不说明跨比较相关条件一致。
